Risk: Reduced human skill acquisition when interacting with superhuman AI systems
Problem analysis: Opacity of AI decision-making in decision-support contexts
Theoretical insight: Natural-language rationales derived from AI internal utilities can improve user learning
Design rationale: Generate rationales by selecting top-k contributing factors from AI utility function
Implementation mechanism: Top-k factor extraction and template-based natural-language generation algorithm
Validation evidence: User study shows RGA+ increases win percentage in chess endgames
Intervention: Deploy RGA-generated textual rationales in AI decision-support interfaces
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.04202
